description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers starting isolated parallel work, trying something on the side without touching the current branch, a fresh workspace with a clean test baseline, and a German phrasing that never names worktrees. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors (cleaning up existing worktrees, a branch-naming convention question, switching the current branch) plus one unrelated counterexample (a database index question).

queries.q: start this in a separate worktree so my current branch stays untouched
try this approach on the side without disturbing what I'm working on
spin up an isolated workspace for this fix and make sure the tests are green there first
arbeite das parallel in einer isolierten Kopie ab, ohne meinen Branch anzufassen
remove all the stale worktrees left over from last week
queries.note: tearing down existing worktrees is /worktree:cleanup, not starting isolated work

queries.q: what should I name the branch for ticket DEV-1234?
queries.note: branch naming is a convention question for git-workflow and the git convention, not workspace isolation

queries.q: switch my checkout over to the release branch
queries.note: changing the current checkout is ordinary branch switching, no second workspace involved

queries.q: which columns should get an index for this slow query?
